tools.name: c64_program
tools.title: Runs PRG/CRT files, uploads BASIC or ASM, and coordinates batch test flows.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for program upload, execution, and batch workflows.

path.description: Path to the PRG image. Use an Ultimate-visible filesystem path on c64u, or a host-local filesystem path on VICE.

symbolsFile.description: Path to a VICE symbol file (.vs) to load alongside the PRG. Symbols are used by the disassemble tool when annotating addresses.

program.description: Commodore BASIC v2 program source to upload and run.

verify.description: Run post-execution polling to ensure the BASIC program executed without errors. Limits depend on op.

autoFix.description: When a BASIC error is detected on screen, append a missing closing quote or parentheses to the failing line and run the program again (default true). The rewritten lines are reported with before and after text. Set false for programs with side effects, which must not run twice.

type.description: Assertion type; sid_silent needs the C64 Ultimate audio stream (c64u backend).

continueOnError.description: Continue running programs after assertion failure

durationMs.description: Duration to run each program before assertions

outputPath.description: Output directory for test results Limits depend on op.

resetDelayMs.description: Delay after reset operations to allow the platform to settle.

captureDebugReg.description: Capture Ultimate debug registers (C64U/U64 only). Defaults to true on C64U/U64 and false on U2/VICE.

messageTemplate.description: Greeting template. Use {PLATFORM}/{BACKEND} for uppercase or {platform}/{backend} for lowercase substitution.

captureScreenshot.description: Capture a framebuffer screenshot on C64U/U64 or VICE. U2 skips screenshots by default; explicitly requesting one on U2 fails before execution.

restoreActiveBackend.description: Restore the backend that was active before the workflow started.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for each greeting to appear on screen.

pollIntervalMs.description: Delay between screen polls while verifying the greeting.

inputSchema.description:
Program operations available via the c64_program tool.

Operations:
- load_prg [write]: Load a PRG from Ultimate storage without executing it. Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: symbolsFile.
- run_prg [write]: Load and execute a PRG from Ultimate-visible storage on C64U/U64 or U2-family hardware, or from a host-local path on VICE. Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: symbolsFile.
- run_crt [c64u, u2] [write]: Mount and run a CRT cartridge image. Required inputs: path.
- upload_run_basic [write]: Upload Commodore BASIC v2 source and execute it immediately. Required inputs: program. Optional inputs: verify, autoFix.
- upload_run_asm [write]: Assemble 6502/6510 source, upload the PRG, and execute it. Required inputs: program. Optional inputs: verify.
- batch_run [write]: Run multiple PRG/CRT programs with post-run assertions. Required inputs: programs. Optional inputs: continueOnError, durationMs, outputPath, resetDelayMs.
- bundle_run [write]: Capture screen, memory, and debug registers into an artifact bundle. Required inputs: runId, outputPath. Optional inputs: captureScreen, memoryRanges, captureDebugReg.
- cross_platform_greeting [write]: Show a platform-customized greeting on one or more configured backends, capture screenshots, and verify the results. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: platforms, messageTemplate, verify, captureScreenshot, outputPath, restoreActiveBackend, timeoutMs, pollIntervalMs.

_meta.summary: Runs PRG/CRT files, uploads BASIC or ASM, and coordinates batch test flows.

examples.description: Load and execute a PRG in one call

examples.description: Send inline BASIC to the C64 and run it

examples.description: Render a platform-specific greeting on VICE and C64U with screenshot verification

workflowHints: Choose BASIC or assembly uploaders based on the language you just generated for the user.
Prefer PRG or CRT runners when the user supplies a file path instead of source text; PRG paths are host-local on VICE and Ultimate-visible on hardware.
For a quick visible confirmation on VICE, C64U/U64, or U2-family hardware, prefer cross_platform_greeting instead of composing manual backend switches and BASIC upload steps.

tools.name: c64_memory
tools.title: Reads or writes RAM, captures the screen, or waits for text matches in one tool.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for memory I/O, screen reads, and screen polling.

address.description: Start address expressed as $HHHH, decimal, or a documented symbol name.

length.description: Number of bytes to read starting from the resolved address. Limits depend on op.

bytes.description: Hex byte sequence like $AABBCC or AA BB CC to write starting at the resolved address.

verify.description: When true, verify the write by reading before and after the change; Ultimate hardware also pauses during verification.

expected.description: Optional hex data expected before the write (verifies before writing).

mask.description: Optional verification mask (hex); only bits set in the mask are compared.

abortOnMismatch.description: Abort the write when the pre-write verification fails.

pattern.description: Substring or regex to find (at most 200 characters; regex with nested quantifiers or backreferences is rejected) Limits depend on op.

instructionCount.description: Stop after this many instructions. When given, it replaces length: 3 x instructionCount bytes are read (fewer near $FFFF).

source.description: Source start address ($HHHH, decimal, or symbol).

startAddress.description: Start of search range ($HHHH, decimal, or symbol).

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path for the output file.

asPrg.description: Prepend a 2-byte little-endian load-address header (PRG format). Default: true.

inputSchema.description:
Memory operations available via the c64_memory tool.

Operations:
- read: Read a range of bytes and return a hex dump with address metadata. Required inputs: address. Optional inputs: length.
- write [write]: Write a hexadecimal byte sequence into RAM. Required inputs: address, bytes. Optional inputs: verify, expected, mask, abortOnMismatch.
- read_screen: Return the current 40x25 text screen converted to ASCII. Required inputs: none.
- wait_for_text: Poll the screen until a substring or regex appears, or timeout elapses. Required inputs: pattern. Optional inputs: isRegex, caseInsensitive, timeoutMs, intervalMs.
- disassemble: Disassemble a memory region into annotated 6502/6510 instructions, including undocumented opcodes with canonical names. Symbol annotations from `.vs` files are applied when available. Works on C64U/U64, U2-family hardware, and VICE. Required inputs: address. Optional inputs: length, instructionCount.
- copy_memory [write]: Copy a RAM region to another address. Required inputs: source, dest, length.
- fill_memory [write]: Fill a memory range with a repeating byte pattern. Required inputs: address, length, pattern.
- search_memory: Search for a byte pattern within a memory range and return matching addresses. Required inputs: startAddress, endAddress, pattern. Optional inputs: maxResults.
- compare_memory: Compare two memory regions byte-by-byte and report differences. Required inputs: address1, address2, length. Optional inputs: maxDiffs.
- save_memory [write]: Dump a memory range to a local file, with an optional PRG load-address header. Required inputs: startAddress, endAddress, filePath. Optional inputs: asPrg.

_meta.summary: Reads or writes RAM, captures the screen, or waits for text matches in one tool.

tools.name: c64_sound
tools.title: Adjusts SID registers, plays files, composes music, and runs verification captures.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for SID control, playback, composition, and analysis workflows.

count.description: Number of stereo sample pairs to capture.

encoding.description: Encoding used for the PCM sample payload.

volume.description: Desired SID master volume. Values outside 0-15 are clamped.

hard.description: If true, perform a hard register scrub; otherwise silence voices softly.

voice.description: SID voice to trigger (1-3). Limits depend on op.

note.description: Musical note like A4, C#5, or Bb3. Overrides frequencyHz if provided.

frequencyHz.description: Explicit frequency in Hz. Used when note is omitted.

waveform.description: SID waveform to enable. Limits depend on op.

pulseWidth.description: Pulse width (0-4095). Used for pulse waveform.

verify.description: When true, record audio after silencing to confirm the SID output is quiet. Limits depend on op.

path.description: Absolute or Ultimate filesystem path to the SID, PRG, or audio file.

songnr.description: Song number within the SID file (0-based index).

root.description: Root note for the arpeggio such as C4 or A#3.

preset.description: Optional musical preset to influence timing/expression. Limits depend on op.

sidwave.description: SIDWAVE composition represented as YAML/JSON text or an already parsed object. Limits depend on op.

cpg.description: SIDWAVE composition represented as YAML/JSON text or an already parsed object. Limits depend on op.

format.description: Source format hint when providing raw text.

output.description: Playback target format. PRG works on all backends; SID playback requires C64U/U64 or U2 (SID export with dryRun works everywhere).

dryRun.description: When true, skip playback and only return compilation metadata.

analysisDurationSeconds.description: Length of the verification recording on analyzable backends. Limits depend on op.

waitBeforeCaptureMs.description: Delay between starting playback and beginning verification capture. Limits depend on op.

restoreActiveBackend.description: Restore the backend that was active before the workflow started.

expectedSidwave.description: Optional expected SIDWAVE used to refine analysis comparisons. Limits depend on op.

verifySilenceBefore.description: Run silence verification before playback to ensure a quiet baseline.

verifySilenceAfter.description: Run silence verification after playback to ensure voices are released.

silenceDurationSeconds.description: Audio capture length used for silence verification.

silenceRmsThreshold.description: RMS threshold applied to silence verification captures.

postSilenceWaitMs.description: Delay between main analysis capture and the post-playback silence check (milliseconds).

silenceWaitMs.description: Delay between silencing the SID and recording during pre/post checks (milliseconds).

request.description: Natural language user request describing the verification goal.

durationSeconds.description: Override capture duration in seconds. Limits depend on op.

inputSchema.description:
Sound operations available via the c64_sound tool.

Operations:
- capture_samples [c64u]: Capture raw stereo PCM samples from the C64 Ultimate audio UDP stream. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: count, encoding.
- set_volume [write]: Set the SID master volume register at $D418 (0-15). Required inputs: volume.
- reset [write]: Soft or hard reset of SID registers to clear glitches. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: hard.
- note_on [write]: Trigger a SID voice with configurable waveform, ADSR, and pitch. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: voice, note, frequencyHz, system, waveform, pulseWidth, attack, decay, sustain, release.
- note_off [write]: Release a SID voice by clearing its gate bit. Required inputs: voice.
- silence_all [write]: Silence all SID voices with optional audio verification. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: verify.
- play_sid_file [c64u, u2] [write]: Play a SID file stored on the Ultimate filesystem. Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: songnr.
- play_mod_file [c64u, u2] [write]: Play a MOD tracker module via the Ultimate SID player. Required inputs: path.
- generate [write]: Generate a lightweight SID arpeggio playback sequence. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: root, pattern, steps, tempoMs, waveform, preset.
- compile_play [write]: Compile SIDWAVE or CPG source and optionally play it immediately. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: sidwave, cpg, format, output, dryRun.
- play_preset [write]: Compile and play a built-in SID preset such as Für Elise by Beethoven. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: preset, platforms, verify, analysisDurationSeconds, waitBeforeCaptureMs, restoreActiveBackend.
- pipeline [write]: Compile a SIDWAVE score, play it, and analyze the recording. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: sidwave, cpg, output, waitBeforeCaptureMs, analysisDurationSeconds, expectedSidwave, verifySilenceBefore, verifySilenceAfter, silenceDurationSeconds, silenceRmsThreshold, postSilenceWaitMs, silenceWaitMs.
- analyze: Automatically analyze SID playback when verification is requested. Required inputs: request. Optional inputs: durationSeconds, expectedSidwave.
- record_analyze: Record audio for a fixed duration and return SID analysis metrics. Uses the Ultimate audio stream on c64u and the host microphone on other backends. Required inputs: durationSeconds. Optional inputs: expectedSidwave.

_meta.summary: Adjusts SID registers, plays files, composes music, and runs verification captures.

tools.name: c64_system
tools.title: Manages machine state (pause, reset, power) and schedules recurring background tasks.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for power, reset, menu, and background task control.

name.description: Unique task name (letters, digits, spaces, '_', '-', '.'; must not start with '.' or a space). Limits depend on op.

operation.description: Operation name: read, write, read_screen or menu_button (read_memory and write_memory are aliases). write requires arguments.address and arguments.bytes.

maxIterations.description: Maximum number of iterations (1 to 100000; omit for indefinite)

includeTimeline.description: Include the tail of the event timeline.

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of span and timeline entries to return.

inputSchema.description:
System operations available via the c64_system tool.

Operations:
- pause [c64u, u2] [write]: Pause the machine until resumed. Required inputs: none.
- resume [c64u, u2] [write]: Resume CPU execution after a pause. Required inputs: none.
- reset [write]: Issue a soft reset without cutting power. Required inputs: none.
- reboot [destructive]: Trigger a firmware reboot to recover from faults. Required inputs: none.
- poweroff [c64u, vice] [destructive]: Shut down C64U/U64 or quit VICE. U2-family hardware cannot power off. On C64U/U64 the machine cannot be restarted by software afterwards: power must be restored at the outlet, and it starts by itself only if automatic startup on power restoration is enabled. Required inputs: none.
- power_cycle [destructive]: Return the active backend to a fresh state. C64U/U64 Tool Menu verification requires machine:menu_screen (a C64U firmware version that provides it, or U64 3.15+); U2-family reboots through REST. Required inputs: none.
- menu [c64u, u2] [write]: Toggle the Ultimate menu button for navigation. Required inputs: none.
- read_menu_screen [c64u, u2]: Read the active Ultimate menu's raw character and colour matrix through machine:menu_screen (a C64U firmware version that provides it, or U64/U2 3.15+). Required inputs: none.
- start_task [write]: Start a named background task that runs on an interval. Required inputs: name, operation. Optional inputs: arguments, intervalMs, maxIterations.
- stop_task [write]: Stop a specific background task and clear its timer. Required inputs: name.
- stop_all_tasks [write]: Stop every running background task and persist state. Required inputs: none.
- list_tasks: List known background tasks with status metadata. Required inputs: none.
- performance_report: Summarize diagnostics spans and tool latencies from the current or latest MCP session. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: scope, includeTimeline, maxEntries.

_meta.summary: Manages machine state (pause, reset, power) and schedules recurring background tasks.

examples.description: Launch a recurring read_screen task

Runtime backend selection operations.

tools.name: c64_graphics
tools.title: Captures frames, renders PETSCII text or art, previews sprites, and displays bitmap images from one tool.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for frame capture and graphics rendering workflows.

includePixels.description: Include raw pixel payload bytes in the response. Off by default because a frame is about 100 KB; the response is rejected above 2 MiB, so lower count when it is on.

format.description: Set to png to receive each frame as an MCP image block (C64 palette). At most 4 frames per call. Limits depend on op.

encoding.description: Encoding used for the pixel payload when included.

prompt.description: Natural language prompt describing the desired PETSCII art.

text.description: Exact text to render in PETSCII (overrides prompt derivation). Limits depend on op.

borderColor.description: Border colour index (0-15). Limits depend on op.

backgroundColor.description: Background colour index (0-15). Limits depend on op.

dryRun.description: When true, skip uploading the generated BASIC program to the C64.

bitmap.description: Explicit bitmap definition for PETSCII rendering.

sprite.description: 63-byte sprite definition provided as base64/hex string or array of bytes.

index.description: Sprite index (0-7) to configure in screen memory.

multicolour.description: Enable multicolour mode for the sprite.

imagePath.description: Filesystem path of the source image (PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and other Jimp-supported formats).

bitmapAddress.description: Absolute C64 memory address, provided as an integer or hex string such as $2000.

screenAddress.description: Absolute C64 memory address, provided as an integer or hex string such as $2000.

preserveAspect.description: Preserve the source image aspect ratio and pad with the background colour.

inputSchema.description:
Graphics operations available via the c64_graphics tool.

Operations:
- capture_frame [c64u, vice]: Capture one or more complete video frames from the active backend. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: count, includePixels, format, encoding.
- render_petscii_art [write]: Create PETSCII art from prompts, text, or explicit bitmap data, and optionally display it on the C64. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: prompt, text, maxWidth, maxHeight, borderColor, backgroundColor, foregroundColor, dryRun, bitmap.
- render_petscii_text [write]: Display PETSCII text with optional border and background colours. Required inputs: text. Optional inputs: borderColor, backgroundColor.
- render_sprite [write]: Display supplied 63-byte sprite data at the requested position and colour by writing memory and patching VIC-II registers directly. Required inputs: sprite. Optional inputs: index, x, y, color, multicolour.
- render_bitmap [write]: Import an image file, convert it to VIC-II bitmap memory, write it into RAM, and display it. Required inputs: imagePath, format. Optional inputs: bitmapAddress, screenAddress, borderColor, backgroundColor, preserveAspect.
- get_display_state: Read VIC-II and CIA2 registers to determine the current graphics mode and memory layout. The same shared-memory path is used on C64U/U64, U2-family hardware, and VICE, so the response shape is identical. Required inputs: none.

tools.name: c64_disk
tools.title: Mount or unmount images, create new disks, list drives, and find programs from one tool.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for disk mounts, listings, image creation, and program discovery.

image.description: Absolute or Ultimate filesystem path to the disk image.

type.description: Override detected image type when firmware guesses incorrectly.

attachmentMode.description: Attachment mode controlling how the firmware treats the mounted image.

driveMode.description: Drive emulation mode to switch to during verification.

verify.description: When true, power on/reset/verify using the reliability workflow.

powerOnIfNeeded.description: Power on the drive automatically before mounting when verify=true.

resetAfterMount.description: Issue a drive reset after mounting when verify=true.

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of mount retries when verify=true.

retryDelayMs.description: Delay between mount retry attempts when verify=true.

path.description: Absolute or Ultimate filesystem path to the disk image to mount or manage.

diskname.description: Optional disk label (1-16 characters, converted to PETSCII).

tracks.description: Track count (D64 supports 35 to 41; DNP requires explicit tracks).

root.description: Root path to search Limits depend on op.

waitMs.description: Delay after firmware run before returning

captureCandidates.description: Include up to this many candidates in result

inputSchema.description:
Disk operations available via the c64_disk tool.

Operations:
- list_drives: List Ultimate drive slots and their mounted images. Required inputs: none.
- mount [write]: Mount a disk image with optional verification and retries. Required inputs: drive, image. Optional inputs: type, attachmentMode, driveMode, verify, powerOnIfNeeded, resetAfterMount, maxRetries, retryDelayMs.
- unmount [c64u, u2] [write]: Remove the mounted image from an Ultimate drive slot. Required inputs: drive.
- file_info [c64u, u2]: Inspect metadata for a file on the Ultimate filesystem. Required inputs: path.
- create_image [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Create a blank disk image of the specified format. Required inputs: format, path. Optional inputs: diskname, tracks.
- find_and_run [c64u, u2] [write]: Search for a PRG/CRT by name substring and run the first match. Required inputs: nameContains. Optional inputs: root, extensions, caseInsensitive, sort, waitMs, captureCandidates.
- find_paths [c64u, u2]: Search Ultimate storage for paths whose names contain a substring, without running anything. Required inputs: nameContains. Optional inputs: root, extensions, maxResults, caseInsensitive.

_meta.summary: Mount or unmount images, create new disks, list drives, and find programs from one tool.

tools.name: c64_config
tools.title: List or update settings, access firmware info, take snapshots, and run program shuffle workflows.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for configuration reads/writes, diagnostics, and snapshots.

category.description: Configuration category reported by the Ultimate firmware (e.g. 'Audio'). Limits depend on op.

item.description: Specific configuration item inside the selected category (e.g. 'Volume'). Limits depend on op.

includeSecretValues.description: Return credential values (network password, FTP/Telnet passwords, Wi-Fi keys) in plain text. Default false: those values are replaced with ***.

value.description: Primitive configuration value (string, number, or boolean). Limits depend on op.

updates.description: Categories mapped to item/value pairs (primitive values only), for example {"Audio": {"Volume": 80}}.

additionalProperties.description: Item/value pairs of one category (primitive values only).

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path where the snapshot file will be written.

applyToFlash.description: When true, save the restored configuration to flash immediately (C64U/U64 and U2 only).

root.description: Root path to search for programs

durationMs.description: Duration to run each program in milliseconds

maxPrograms.description: Maximum number of programs to run

outputPath.description: Output directory for run logs and captures

resetDelayMs.description: Delay after reset operations to allow the platform to settle.

inputSchema.description:
Configuration operations available via the c64_config tool.

Operations:
- list: List configuration categories reported by the firmware. Required inputs: none.
- get: Read a configuration category or specific item. Required inputs: category. Optional inputs: item, includeSecretValues.
- set [write]: Write a configuration value in the selected category. Required inputs: category, item, value.
- batch_update [write]: Apply multiple configuration updates in a single request. Pass `updates` as {category: {item: value}}; categories as top-level keys are still accepted at runtime. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: updates.
- load_flash [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Load configuration from flash storage. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: category.
- save_flash [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Persist the current configuration to flash storage. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: category.
- reset_defaults [c64u, u2] [destructive]: Reset firmware configuration to factory defaults. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: category.
- read_debugreg [c64u]: Read the Ultimate debug register ($D7FF). Required inputs: none.
- write_debugreg [c64u] [destructive]: Write a hex value to the Ultimate debug register ($D7FF). Required inputs: value.
- info: Retrieve Ultimate hardware information and status. Required inputs: none.
- version: Fetch firmware version details. Required inputs: none.
- snapshot [write]: Snapshot configuration to disk for later restore or diff. Required inputs: path.
- restore [write]: Restore configuration from a snapshot file. Required inputs: path. Optional inputs: applyToFlash.
- diff: Compare the current configuration with a snapshot. Required inputs: path.
- shuffle [c64u, u2] [write]: Discover PRG/CRT files and run each with optional screen capture. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: root, extensions, durationMs, captureScreen, maxPrograms, outputPath, resetDelayMs.

_meta.summary: List or update settings, access firmware info, take snapshots, and run program shuffle workflows.

tools.name: c64_extract
tools.title: Export sprites or charsets, dump RAM, compute filesystem stats, or run firmware health checks.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for sprite/charset extraction, memory dumps, filesystem stats, and firmware health checks.

pauseDuringRead.description: Pause the machine during memory read

inputSchema.description:
Extraction operations available via the c64_extract tool.

Operations:
- sprites [write]: Scan RAM for sprites and optionally export .spr files. Required inputs: address, length. Optional inputs: stride, maxSprites, minNonZeroRows, minSetBits, includeBase64, outputDir, pauseDuringRead.
- charset [write]: Locate and extract 2KB character sets from RAM. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: address, scanRange, outputPath, pauseDuringRead, minNonEmptyChars, minEntropy.
- memory_dump [write]: Dump a RAM range to hex or binary files with manifest metadata. Required inputs: address, length, outputPath. Optional inputs: format, chunkSize, pauseDuringRead, retries.
- fs_stats [c64u, u2]: Walk the filesystem and aggregate counts/bytes by extension. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: root, extensions, includeContainers, maxSamplesPerExtension.
- firmware_health: Run firmware readiness checks and report status metrics. Required inputs: none.

_meta.summary: Export sprites or charsets, dump RAM, compute filesystem stats, or run firmware health checks.

tools.name: c64_debug
tools.title: Manage breakpoints, inspect registers, and step through code on the VICE backend.
tools.description: Grouped entry point for VICE debugger operations (breakpoints, registers, stepping).

enabled.description: Whether the checkpoint is enabled (default true). Limits depend on op.

items.description: Selects a register by id or name.

expectedPC.description: Target PC address to wait for (e.g. $0810).

inputSchema.description:
Available debugger operations.

Operations:
- list_checkpoints: List all active VICE checkpoints (breakpoints). Required inputs: none.
- get_checkpoint: Fetch a single checkpoint by id. Required inputs: id.
- create_checkpoint [write]: Create a new checkpoint (breakpoint) in VICE. Required inputs: address. Optional inputs: endAddress, stopOnHit, enabled, temporary, label, operations, memspace.
- delete_checkpoint [write]: Remove a checkpoint by id. Required inputs: id.
- toggle_checkpoint [write]: Enable or disable a checkpoint by id. Required inputs: id, enabled.
- set_condition [write]: Attach a conditional expression to a checkpoint. Required inputs: id, expression.
- list_registers: List available registers (metadata). Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: memspace.
- get_registers: Read register values, optionally filtered by name or id. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: memspace, registers.
- set_registers [write]: Write register values. Required inputs: writes. Optional inputs: memspace.
- step [write]: Single-step CPU execution. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: count, mode.
- step_return [write]: Continue execution until the current routine returns. Required inputs: none.
- get_monitor_state: Read CPU registers and return the current monitor state. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: memspace.
- wait_for_state: Poll CPU registers until PC equals expectedPC or timeout elapses. Required inputs: none. Optional inputs: expectedPC, timeoutMs, pollMs.
- nuclear_reset [write]: Kill and restart the VICE process (managed instances only). Required inputs: none.
- continue_execution [write]: Exit the Binary Monitor and resume CPU execution (BM 0xAA Exit). Required inputs: none.

_meta.summary: Manage breakpoints, inspect registers, and step through code on the VICE backend.

tools.name: c64_input
tools.title: Types text, sends physical key combinations, and controls joysticks.
tools.description: Cross-platform PETSCII typing plus native Ultimate keyboard and joystick events.

text.description: Text to type: printable ASCII (letters are sent as PETSCII upper case), \n for RETURN, and {TOKEN}s such as {RETURN}, {CLR}, {F1}…{F8}, {UP}, {DOWN}, {LEFT}, {RIGHT}, colour names, or {$1D}/{29} codes. Characters with no PETSCII mapping and unknown tokens are rejected.

key.description: Key to press: a printable character, or a PETSCII token name (RETURN, F1…F8, UP, etc.).

durationMs.description: Delay in ms after each queued key press before the next press (default 0 = no delay). Limits depend on op.

count.description: Number of times to press the key (default 1).

controls.description: List of controls to activate simultaneously.

action.description: press = hold until a release call; release = restore all bits; tap = press then release after durationMs.

inputs.description: One or more keys to transition together (for example left_shift + a).

transition.description: press holds, release frees, tap presses and releases.

inputSchema.description:
Input operations: write_text, key, keyboard, joystick, release_all, state.

Operations:
- write_text [write]: Send a text string to the keyboard buffer, with PETSCII token expansion. Required inputs: text. Optional inputs: delayMs.
- key [write]: Press a single key one or more times, optionally with a delay between presses. Required inputs: key. Optional inputs: durationMs, count.
- joystick [c64u, vice] [write]: Simulate joystick input. On C64U/U64 this uses machine:input. On VICE it attaches VICE's I/O simulation joyport device while pressed; that device also pulls CIA lines 5-7 low, so port 1 produces phantom keys (e.g. SHIFT+C=) and port 2 reads $1E for up instead of $7E. Prefer port 2 on VICE and test bits 0-4. Required inputs: port, controls, action. Optional inputs: durationMs.
- keyboard [c64u] [write]: Send physical C64 keyboard matrix events through machine:input (a C64U firmware version that provides it, or U64 3.15+). Required inputs: inputs, transition.
- release_all [c64u] [write]: Release every key and joystick control injected through machine:input (a C64U firmware version that provides it, or U64 3.15+). Required inputs: none.
- state [c64u]: Read the keys and joystick controls held through machine:input (a C64U firmware version that provides it, or U64 3.15+). Required inputs: none.

_meta.summary: Types text, sends physical key combinations, and controls joysticks.

workflowHints: Use write_text with {RETURN} tokens to automate BASIC entry; use key for one PETSCII/KERNAL queue key. Neither is for navigating Ultimate firmware menus.
write_text and key inject through the KERNAL keyboard queue ($0277/$00C6) so they work on both C64U and VICE.

Use keyboard for physical C64 key combinations (including modifiers) on machine:input, and release_all to recover from interrupted holds. It requires a C64U firmware version that provides the endpoint, or U64 3.15+.
Before native input, read c64://platform/status. If machine:input is unavailable or unknown, use key or write_text for ordinary C64 input instead of attempting physical matrix events.

Change C64U/U64/U2 configuration through c64_config REST operations, never by keyboard menu navigation. Use keyboard navigation only where REST has no equivalent, such as the machine code monitor, visual SID editor, or Tool Menu.
Joystick uses machine:input on a C64U firmware version that provides the endpoint or U64 3.15+; VICE supports up/down/left/right/fire through its monitor.
